xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1837: Support Kimi Code as a first-class harness (Moonshot's own coding CLI)

plan.title: Support Kimi Code as a first-class harness (Moonshot's own coding CLI)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Adding a harness is a single inseparable deliverable: getHarness() silently coerces any partially-registered harness string to claude-code, so a partial ship either runs Kimi agents as Claude or crashes at runtime dispatch. The issue explicitly mandates 'single deliverable — no partial ship'. Items are decomposed for reviewability (16 tracer slices with per-item tests) but cannot ship as sibling issues.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck can run Kimi models only through claude-code pointed at Kimi's Anthropic-compatibility endpoint (which forfeits Moonshot's server-side context caching discipline) or through the generic acp harness (a portability layer that cannot reach Kimi-specific capabilities). Neither drives Kimi Code's native agent loop. Moonshot's own CLI (`kimi`) is a Claude-Code-class terminal agent; without a native harness, Kimi models are second-class in Overdeck.
narratives.Proposal: Add 'kimi-code' as a fifth harness that drives the native `kimi` TUI: launch `cd <workspace> && kimi -m <model> --yolo` under the PTY supervisor in the agent's tmux session (async tmux-paste fallback), readiness via the native session dir appearing (kimi-session-signal), session id captured post-launch (newest dir under the workspace's workDirKey bucket, persisted per-agent like codex's thread-id), transcript and cost parsed from Kimi's own wire.jsonl. Kimi-provider-only policy gate mirrors acp. The existing acp harness coexists untouched. Shipped provider default flips to kimi-code only as the final item, gated on a proven end-to-end work-agent run (two-phase default, PRD WI-7.1).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Kimi Code through ACP: the existing acp harness is its own shipped path and must remain byte-for-byte unchanged (no merge, delete, or re-point)
- Kimi headless -p/--print roles: v1 work agents run interactively; a one-shot headless role type is a follow-up
- Kimi sub-agent transcripts (agents/agent-0/…/wire.jsonl): v1 renders only the main agent's wire
- Setting the operator override providerHarnesses.kimi: 'acp': that is Settings/config, not code in this diff
- Silent harness fallback or coercion: {kimi-code, non-Kimi model} must block with a reason, never coerce (NFR-2)
- A second `kimi` prerequisite row (would double-report in pan doctor)
- Sync tmux primitives (sendKeys) or execSync anywhere in new code (NFR-3)

autoDecisions.summary: Reused the canonical PRD at drafts/PAN-1837.md on overdeck-state instead of authoring a new one.
autoDecisions.rationale: All of its verified file/line anchors were re-checked against the workspace tree at d266109a1d and held; only a planning-errata section was appended.

autoDecisions.summary: Launcher acceptance criteria encode `cd <workspace> && kimi -m <model> --yolo` with no --session, no --work-dir, no --print — superseding the PRD's stale WI-6 test line and acceptance criterion 5.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD's own [RESOLVED — verified 0.29.2] checkpoint establishes -S cannot create arbitrary session ids and --work-dir does not exist; the resolved sections are authoritative over the stale lines (erratum E1 in the PRD draft).

autoDecisions.summary: Delivery is pty-supervisor primary with async tmux-paste fallback; a spike item pins the wire.jsonl fixture and resolves the live delivery checkpoint before adapter hardening.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD states this default and fallback explicitly and orders checkpoint resolution early ('spawn one throwaway kimi-code agent by hand … pin both as fixtures').

autoDecisions.summary: Context layers reuse the shared AGENTS.md layer and ~/.agents/skills; no new kimi-code-global.md render file.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD WI-9 names this the default ('reuse the shared AGENTS.md layer, no new file'); Kimi Code reads AGENTS.md natively.

autoDecisions.summary: The shipped PROVIDERS.kimi.defaultHarness flip to 'kimi-code' is the final item, blocked by the end-to-end verification item.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD WI-7.1 two-phase decision: flipping forces the kimi binary on every Kimi user, so it lands proven, not before; the interim caching default is the operator config override, not code.

autoDecisions.summary: Prerequisites: broaden the existing `kimi` entry's purpose string; no duplicate probe.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD WI-10's stated decision — both harnesses share one binary and a second row would double-report in pan doctor.
